lines.description: The requested lines. An order must have at least one.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit ordered. Must be non-empty.

quantity.description: Quantity ordered. Must be greater than zero.

pathId.description: OPTIONAL wes-work-planning process path this line's work is enqueued onto at release time. Defaults to `pick` when omitted — a documented v1 simplification (path selection is not yet a domain policy here).

giftWrap.description: OPTIONAL. Whether the requester asked the warehouse to produce a gift package for this line. Passed straight through to wes-work-planning's already-optional `giftWrap` field at release time — a caller-stated characteristic, never looked up.

allowPartialShipment.description: When false (the default — ship-complete, BR3), a single backordered line holds the WHOLE order back from release until retry-allocation clears it. When true, allocated lines are independently eligible for release.
